title: Adaptive Batch-Wise Sample Scheduling for Direct Preference Optimization
authors_zh: Zixuan Huang、Yikun Ban、Lean Fu、Xiaojie Li、Zhongxiang Dai、Jianxin Li、Deqing Wang（北京航空航天大学、字节跳动、香港中文大学（深圳））
paper_type_zh: 动态偏好样本调度与直接偏好优化研究
best_for_zh: 适合研究偏好数据应在训练过程的何时、以何种顺序被模型使用的读者。
one_line: SamS dynamically schedules the preference pairs used by each DPO batch from learning feedback.
SamS 根据模型在每个批次中的学习反馈，动态安排 DPO 实际使用的偏好对。
why: It turns preference-data use from a static pre-filtering decision into a model-state-dependent training decision.
inclusion_reason: Changes which preference records are consumed at each DPO update by using the model's evolving learning feedback.

title: Problem
问题
html:
Direct Preference Optimization depends on the quality of fixed preference pairs, yet most selection methods decide which pairs to keep before training begins. A pair that is useful early can become too easy, unhelpful, or misleading after the policy changes; noisy labels can make this mismatch worse. Static filtering therefore leaves the training stream detached from the model state that is actually consuming it.

SamS asks how an offline DPO run can decide, batch by batch, which available preference pairs should update the current policy. It treats sample choice as a scheduling problem: the decision should follow current learning feedback, so a fixed dataset can be consumed in a sequence that is better aligned with the policy's evolving capacity.

直接偏好优化依赖固定偏好对的质量，但多数选择方法在训练开始前就决定保留哪些偏好对。某个样本对在早期可能有用，随着策略变化却可能变得过于简单、没有帮助，甚至具有误导性；带噪声的标签会进一步加剧这种错配。因此，静态筛选使训练数据流脱离了实际使用这些数据的模型状态。

SamS 追问离线 DPO 训练应如何逐批决定哪些现有偏好对更新当前策略。它把样本选择视为调度问题：这一决策应当跟随当前的学习反馈，使固定数据集能以更贴合策略能力演化的顺序被使用。

title: Core idea
核心思路
html:
The central idea is to put a small scheduler beside, rather than inside, the DPO objective. For every incoming batch, the scheduler observes representations of the candidate preference pairs and of the policy state, then chooses a top-K subset for the DPO update. The original DPO loss is unchanged; what changes is the set of records to which that loss is applied.

SamS frames this repeated choice as a contextual bandit. Its reward combines whether the policy's loss improves on subsequent batches with whether an individual pair has a clear preference margin and remains uncertain for the current model. A separate exploration network prevents the scheduler from repeatedly trusting only the samples that already look familiar.

核心想法是在 DPO 目标之外、而非其内部，放置一个轻量调度器。对于每个到来的批次，调度器观察候选偏好对以及策略状态的表示，然后选择一个 top-K 子集进行 DPO 更新。原始 DPO 损失并不改变；改变的是该损失应用于哪些记录。

SamS 将这种重复选择表述为上下文老虎机问题。它的奖励同时考虑策略在后续批次上的损失是否改善，以及单条偏好对是否具有清晰的偏好间隔、且对当前模型仍然不确定。独立的探索网络防止调度器反复只信任那些看起来已经熟悉的样本。

title: Method
方法
html:
At round t, SamS encodes each prompt, chosen response, and rejected response in the incoming batch as an arm context. A scheduler scores the arms and selects K of N pairs; the policy is then updated with ordinary DPO on only those pairs. The training feedback supplies a batch-level reward from the change in normalized DPO loss and a sample-level reward from preference margin and model uncertainty.

The scheduler is trained with a lagged update in the next round, allowing the method to collect the relevant loss feedback during normal policy training instead of running a separate evaluation loop. The scheduler contains exploitation and exploration components, and the authors report experiments with 64-pair batches and 32 scheduled pairs, across instruction-following evaluation and public preference datasets.

在第 t 轮中，SamS 将到来批次里的每个提示、优选回答和拒选回答编码为一个臂的上下文。调度器为这些臂打分并从 N 个偏好对中选择 K 个；随后，策略仅在这些偏好对上执行普通 DPO 更新。训练反馈提供两类奖励：一类来自归一化 DPO 损失变化的批次级奖励，另一类来自偏好间隔和模型不确定性的样本级奖励。

调度器在下一轮使用滞后更新进行训练，使方法能够在正常的策略训练中收集所需损失反馈，而无需额外运行评估循环。该调度器包含利用与探索两个部分；作者报告了每批 64 个偏好对、调度其中 32 个的实验，并在指令跟随评估与公开偏好数据集上进行测试。

title: Evidence
证据
html:
The NeurIPS paper evaluates the scheduler on AlpacaEval 2 and MT-Bench, compares it with offline preference-optimization baselines, and separately tests transfer on Anthropic-HH and SHP. In the main instruction-following experiments, adding SamS to DPO improves AlpacaEval 2 win rate by 3.0 to 12.4 percentage points and length-controlled win rate by 5.5 to 8.4 points relative to the reported baselines.

The authors also test noisy preference labels and report that the scheduled variant is more robust than plain DPO. On Anthropic-HH, their table reports 67.1 test accuracy for DPO plus SamS versus 64.3 for DPO; on the same data, KTO plus SamS reaches 63.3 versus 60.2 for KTO. These results support a scheduling effect, though they are evaluations of the proposed policy-training recipe rather than proof that every chosen pair is intrinsically better.

NeurIPS 论文在 AlpacaEval 2 和 MT-Bench 上评估该调度器，与离线偏好优化基线比较，并在 Anthropic-HH 和 SHP 上单独测试迁移效果。在主要的指令跟随实验中，相对于论文报告的基线，将 SamS 加入 DPO 后，AlpacaEval 2 胜率提高 3.0 至 12.4 个百分点，长度控制胜率提高 5.5 至 8.4 个百分点。

作者还测试了带噪声的偏好标签，并报告调度版本比普通 DPO 更具鲁棒性。在 Anthropic-HH 上，其表格报告 DPO 加 SamS 的测试准确率为 67.1，而 DPO 为 64.3；同一数据上，KTO 加 SamS 达到 63.3，而 KTO 为 60.2。这些结果支持调度带来的影响，但它们评估的是所提出的策略训练方案，并不能证明每一个被选中的偏好对本身都更优。

title: Novelty
新意
html:
Earlier preference-data work commonly asks which examples to annotate, which response pairs to form, or which fixed subset to filter before optimization. SamS changes the decision point: it repeatedly selects from an already available batch while the DPO policy changes. This makes the training consumer's current state an explicit input to preference-data use.

The distinctive mechanism is not a new preference corpus or a replacement DPO loss. It is the combination of state-conditioned top-K scheduling, a reward that mixes future-batch loss reduction with pair-level margin and uncertainty, and a lagged update that avoids a separate reward-collection pass. The public implementation makes this distinction practical to inspect and reproduce.

较早的偏好数据研究通常询问应标注哪些样本、应构成哪些回答对，或在优化之前应筛选哪个固定子集。SamS 改变了决策发生的位置：在 DPO 策略不断变化的同时，它从已经到来的批次中反复选择。这使训练使用者的当前状态成为偏好数据使用的显式输入。

其独特机制不是新的偏好语料，也不是替换 DPO 损失。它结合了依赖状态的 top-K 调度、混合后续批次损失下降与样本对间隔和不确定性的奖励，以及无需单独收集奖励过程的滞后更新。公开实现使这种区别能够被实际检查和复现。

title: Limitations
局限
html: SamS is sensitive to the quality of its fixed preference pool: the authors note that its relative advantage shrinks when abundant high-quality response pairs are already available, and noisy labels can still distort the scheduler's feedback. Its reward uses loss, margin, and uncertainty as proxies for future generalization, so a scheduler may learn dataset- or model-specific correlations rather than a portable notion of value. The added networks and stateful schedule also introduce tuning choices, while reuse still requires checking the licenses, splits, and possible benchmark overlap of every upstream preference dataset and automatic judge.
SamS 对固定偏好池的质量很敏感：作者指出，当已经拥有大量高质量回答对时，它的相对优势会缩小，而带噪声的标签仍可能扭曲调度器的反馈。其奖励以损失、间隔和不确定性作为未来泛化的代理，因此调度器可能学到数据集或模型特有的相关性，而不是可迁移的价值概念。新增网络和有状态的调度也带来调参选择；复用时仍必须检查每个上游偏好数据集与自动评判器的许可证、数据划分和可能的基准重叠。

title: Usefulness
用途
html: This paper is useful when a team already has an offline preference dataset and wants to improve how DPO consumes it without relabeling the corpus or changing the DPO objective. It offers a concrete design for online-in-training record allocation, plus code that can be inspected for scheduler state, rewards, top-K ratio, and overhead. It is most relevant to alignment, instruction following, and any preference-learning setting where the same records should not necessarily receive equal attention throughout training.
当团队已经拥有离线偏好数据集，并希望在不重标注语料、也不改变 DPO 目标的情况下改善其使用方式时，这篇论文很有用。它为训练过程中在线分配记录提供了具体设计，并提供可检查的代码，以查看调度器状态、奖励、top-K 比例和额外开销。它最适用于对齐、指令跟随，以及任何不应让同一批记录在整个训练期间始终获得相同关注度的偏好学习场景。

title: Reading notes
阅读笔记
html: Read the problem formulation and reward definition before the headline results: the key claim is about scheduling data use, not simply filtering a better static subset. Then inspect the ablations for the batch-level and sample-level rewards, exploration network, selected fraction, noise setting, and transfer across DPO-like objectives. For replication, start from the official repository and record the exact upstream preference data, model checkpoint, automatic judge, batch size, scheduled fraction, and evaluation protocol; these choices determine whether a reported improvement is comparable.
应在阅读醒目的结果之前先阅读问题表述和奖励定义：关键主张是对数据使用进行调度，而不只是筛出一个更好的静态子集。随后检查批次级与样本级奖励、探索网络、选取比例、噪声设置以及跨 DPO 类目标迁移的消融实验。复现时应从官方仓库开始，并记录确切的上游偏好数据、模型检查点、自动评判器、批次大小、调度比例和评估协议；这些选择决定报告的改进是否可比较。
